title: Whole 2nd floor has no internet
symptoms: PCs show 169.254.x.x addresses; floor 1 is fine

history.text: 169.254 = no DHCP. Floor 1 OK -> DHCP server alive; floor-2 switch suspect
Floor-2 switch uplink port LED off; reseated cable - link up
Cause: uplink cable knocked loose during desk move | Fix: reseated + labeled cable, clients renewed DHCP

root_cause: Uplink cable knocked loose during desk move
fix: Reseated and labeled cable; clients renewed DHCP
